name: Astarta Holding PLC
summary: Astarta is a vertically integrated agro-industrial holding company with primary operations in Ukraine. The company's main activities include crop production of sugar beet, soybeans, wheat, and corn, alongside sugar production, cattle farming for milk, and soybean processing. It manages approximately 213,000 hectares of agricultural land and its products are sold in both domestic Ukrainian and global markets. The company also has a bioenergy segment that produces biogas.
